jobs.title: Chargé(e) de projets agiles
jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. Tu accompagnes l’équipe tout au long de la réalisation des projets, identifies les obstacles en cours de route et veilles à l’amélioration continue de leur processus de travail. Tu agis comme partenaire d'affaires auprès des équipes, en traduisant les données financières en analyses claires et actionnables qui éclairent la rentabilité, les marges et les coûts. Tu profites de chaque occasion pour moderniser les façons de faire de la fonction finance, en tirant parti des outils technologiques et de l'intelligence artificielle pour simplifier le travail de ton équipe. Tu sais que ton succès se mesure à une information financière plus fiable et plus rapidement disponible, à une rentabilité mieux comprise et mieux suivie, et à une équipe qui adopte avec enthousiasme de nouveaux outils. Ce poste est pour toi si tu souhaites grandir avec la fonction finance et prendre éventuellement plus de responsabilités dans un contexte d'entreprise en évolution.

Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution and knows how to navigate culturally dynamic, fast-moving markets.

This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity. Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape.

jobs.description_text: We are currently looking for a new band member to join the Spotify Tax Team. This new band member will be an Analyst, joining the Global Indirect Tax Team. This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden. In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams. We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.
